layout_sections.name: 04 // SELECTED WORK - Four Flagship Case Studies
layout_sections.specs: py-24 px-6 sm:px-10 lg:px-16 max-w-7xl mx-auto border-t border-[#1E2638]

projects.title: ChainSentinel
projects.tagline: Automated Smart Contract Vulnerability & Gas Analyzer
projects.overview: A developer-first smart contract security auditing suite that parses Solidity ASTs and bytecode to detect critical reentrancy vulnerabilities, unchecked transfers, and sub-optimal storage layouts before mainnet deployment.
features: Detects SWC registry common patterns (Reentrancy SWC-107, TX.Origin SWC-115)
Gas profile comparison between multiple contract revisions
Interactive AST visualization for external calls & state mutations

projects.title: ChainEscrow
projects.overview: Trustless payment orchestration protocol designed for freelance engineering agreements. Funds are locked in EVM escrow and disbursed strictly upon multi-signature cryptographic approval of verifiable deliverables.
features: Milestone-based staged fund release with automated 2-of-3 arbiter dispute resolution
Emergency timelock withdrawal pattern preventing locked fund deadlocks
Clean Web3 transaction status modal with live block confirmation stepper

projects.title: LendGuard
projects.overview: An educational peer-to-pool liquidity protocol demonstrating core money-market mechanics: dynamic interest rate curves based on pool utilization, real-time health factor calculations, and automated Dutch-auction liquidations.
features: Interest Rate Model: Utilization-based kinked curve (Borrow Rate = Base + U * Slope)
Health Factor monitor with simulated price shock volatility stress-tests
Flash loan protection via internal reentrancy locks and state synchronization

projects.title: VerifiChain
projects.overview: A decentralized verification platform where academic institutions issue cryptographically signed credentials. Crucially, raw student records remain off-chain for GDPR/privacy compliance, while SHA-256/Keccak-256 Merkle roots are anchored on Ethereum.
features: Zero Data Tampering: Instant zero-knowledge style public verification via cryptographic hashing
Dual-layer architecture: Private student metadata off-chain + public immutable validity on-chain
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) allowing registered universities to issue & revoke credentials

layout_sections.name: 05 // PROCESS - 7-Step Web3 Engineering Lifecycle
layout_sections.specs: py-24 px-6 sm:px-10 lg:px-16 max-w-7xl mx-auto border-t border-[#1E2638]

steps.name: DEFINE
steps.desc: Determine threat model, tokenomics, state boundaries & gas cost ceilings.

steps.name: ARCHITECT
steps.desc: Draft state machine, storage slot layouts, inheritance trees & off-chain touchpoints.

steps.name: BUILD
steps.desc: Implement Solidity contracts with OpenZeppelin modules and defensive patterns.

steps.name: TEST
steps.desc: Forge fuzz testing, invariant tests, 100% branch coverage, and mock failure states.

steps.name: DEPLOY
steps.desc: Deterministic deployment (CREATE2), verification on block explorers & multisig setups.

steps.name: DOCUMENT
steps.desc: NatSpec annotations, clear user guides, protocol architecture specs & SDK examples.

steps.name: DEFEND
steps.desc: Continuous monitoring, circuit breakers, emergency pause routines & bug bounty reviews.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the placeholder splash screen in App.js with the full-featured, award-winning portfolio matching this exact schema.
2. Set up clean routing using React Router: '/' for the complete single-page interactive portfolio, plus dedicated sub-routes '/project/:id' for deep dive case-study breakdowns.
3. Add all specified data-testid attributes to buttons, nav links, modal triggers, tech filters, and contact forms for seamless test execution.
4. Ensure header uses glassmorphism with dark background (NOT transparent) so text remains ultra-crisp over any background elements.
5. Use Lucide icons (Shield, Cpu, Network, Blocks, Code, Lock, Award, ExternalLink, Github, Linkedin, Copy, Check, Terminal, Zap) consistently.

6. Include interactive components: Live interactive SVG blockchain network visualizer in the hero, live project preview modal, filterable tech matrix, and interactive contact console with toast confirmation (using sonner).
7. Implement responsive design for mobile (drawer navigation, stackable grids, touch-friendly tap targets).
8. Maintain high visual contrast: stark white text on dark obsidian surfaces with electric violet (#8B5CF6), cyan (#06B6D4), and emerald (#10B981) highlights.
